faqs.a: Duplicate headers get suffixed automatically (name, name_2, name_3) in most tools, but here the safest approach is to rename the header row before converting. This tool keeps the last value for a repeated key, so check your headers first.

faqs.a: Yes, if the first row contains data rather than headers, turn off First row is header. The output becomes an array of arrays instead of an array of objects.

faqs.a: Turn on Detect types. Plain numbers become JSON numbers, true/false become booleans, and empty cells become null. Codes with leading zeros like 00123 stay as strings only if you leave detection off; with it on, they become numbers, so keep it off for such data.
faqs.q: How do I keep numbers as numbers?

faqs.a: Quoted fields follow the standard rules: double quotes inside are escaped as two quotes, and line breaks inside quoted fields are preserved as \n in the JSON strings.
